subject: [FAQ] different result before and after v3.5.6

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: [FAQ] different result before and after v3.5.6
parts:
Dear MSstats users,

Please check the detailed updates in 'Changes since the previous version' pdf files from MSstats home page or 'MSstats' page of msstats.org

After v3.5.6 of MSstats, one of the significant update is that MSstats applies the algorithm for deciding the data-specific censoring threshold. Then, inference result (result of groupComparison) can be different that previous version. The related option is maxQuantileforCensored=0.999 in dataProcess function. and now you can see which measurements are censored in profile plots. (empty dots) If you don't want to apply it, please use maxQuantileforCensored=NULL. Then the result will be the same with the result from v3.2.

- Meena
